disclaimer: Model confidence is not evidence of folding, binding, affinity, efficacy, safety, or experimental validation.

plddt_bins.label: very high local model confidence
plddt_bins.text: pLDDT {value:.1f} (90-100): very high local model confidence. This is the model's own estimate of local accuracy for a predicted structure; it is not an experimental observation.

plddt_bins.label: relatively high local model confidence
plddt_bins.text: pLDDT {value:.1f} (70-90): relatively high local model confidence. This describes the model's estimate of local backbone accuracy, not experimentally observed folding or function.

plddt_bins.label: low local model confidence
plddt_bins.text: pLDDT {value:.1f} (50-70): low local model confidence. Treat the local geometry as uncertain.

plddt_bins.label: very low local model confidence
plddt_bins.text: pLDDT {value:.1f} (below 50): very low local model confidence. Low values can occur in regions the model could not place reliably, including flexible or disordered regions, so this value alone does not say which.

templates.plddt_region: Residues {residue_range} of chain {chain} ({n} residues): mean pLDDT {mean:.1f}. Fraction of residues by bin: {bin_summary}. These are model confidence values from a predicted structure.
templates.pae_region: Predicted aligned error (PAE) for residues {residue_range} of chain {chain}: mean {mean:.1f} A, maximum {max:.1f} A across {n_pairs} residue pairs. PAE is the model's estimate of the expected position error of one residue when the structure is aligned on another, so it is a relative uncertainty between residue pairs. Lower values mean lower predicted relative uncertainty.
templates.pae_interchain: Mean PAE between chain {chain_a} and chain {chain_b}: {mean:.1f} A over {n_pairs} residue pairs. This is the model's relative uncertainty about how the two chains are positioned with respect to each other.
templates.rmsd: Root-mean-square deviation (RMSD) {rmsd:.2f} A, computed on {aligned_atoms} {atom_type} atoms from {aligned_residues} aligned residues (mobile: {mobile}, reference: {reference}). RMSD measures average positional difference over only those atoms, and is sensitive to outlier regions and to which atoms were selected.
templates.rmsd_small_n: Only {aligned_atoms} atoms were aligned, so this RMSD describes a very small part of the structure.
templates.tm_score: TM-score {tm:.3f}. TM-score is a length-normalised structural similarity measure between 0 and 1; higher means greater similarity of the aligned backbones. It does not describe function.
templates.tm_missing: No TM-score was reported for this alignment.
templates.exp_vs_pred: Comparison of an experimental structure ({exp_id}) with a predicted model ({pred_id}). The experimental structure is derived from measured data for the deposited sample; the predicted model is a computational estimate. A low RMSD or high TM-score indicates the two coordinate sets are similar over the aligned atoms. It does not by itself indicate that either structure is correct for other conditions or states.
templates.exp_vs_pred_plddt: Mean pLDDT of the predicted model over the compared residues was {mean:.1f}.
templates.interface: Interface between chain {chain_a} and chain {chain_b} in {structure}: {n_contacts} residue pairs with heavy atoms within {cutoff:.1f} A. Mean pLDDT of interface residues is {iface_plddt:.1f}. Mean inter-chain PAE is {iface_pae:.1f} A. These numbers describe model confidence in the relative placement of the chains in the coordinates; they are not measurements of any physical property.
templates.interface_experimental: Interface between chain {chain_a} and chain {chain_b} in experimental entry {structure}: {n_contacts} residue pairs with heavy atoms within {cutoff:.1f} A, computed from the deposited coordinates. No model-confidence scores apply to experimental coordinates.
templates.no_confidence_experimental: Residues {residue_range} of chain {chain} ({n} residues) come from an experimental structure. No model-confidence scores apply to experimental coordinates: the B-factor column of this file holds experimental B-factors, which are a different quantity from pLDDT, so neither pLDDT nor PAE is reported for it.
templates.no_confidence_unlabelled: Residues {residue_range} of chain {chain} ({n} residues) come from a file that was not declared to be a predicted model. Its B-factor column is therefore not read as pLDDT, and no model-confidence scores are reported for it. A designed backbone, for example, carries no confidence values of its own.
templates.low_identity_matching: The matched residues share {identity_pct:.0f}% sequence identity, so pairing them by sequence alignment may not reflect the intended residue correspondence. If the two structures use the same residue numbering, matching by residue number pairs position {example} with position {example} directly.
templates.interface_coordinates_only: Interface between chain {chain_a} and chain {chain_b} in {structure}: {n_contacts} residue pairs with heavy atoms within {cutoff:.1f} A, computed from the coordinates in this file. No model-confidence scores are reported for this interface.
